report: 初始网络脚本错误地把已加载页面reload称为cold offline，并假定它一定失败；该实验没有隔离缓存或页面级CDP限速。改为独立新context、禁用ServiceWorker、唯一URL后实测离线首导航失败，联网重试恢复。

scope.rationale: QA-only branch correction, no game defect established, runtime untouched and no FIX attempt opened.

steps: Run preserved initial network driver: previously loaded page reused for offline reload
Run corrected driver: fresh context, serviceWorkers block, offline=true, unique URL
Reconnect original online page and confirm startup recovery
observed: Initial five positive checks and one unsupported cold-start assertion failure; no runtime page errors
Fresh independent cold offline navigation actually rejects; reconnect/reload and file standalone both work

acceptanceCriteria: Preserve failed network report and driver
Cold-first-navigation branch must use a fresh uncached context
Do not claim service-worker offline support or rely on cache from an earlier navigation
